env.//: keep playwright-cli snapshots/console logs out of the working tree

hooks.command: test "$(git config --get core.hooksPath)" = .githooks || { git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'restored core.hooksPath -> .githooks (project hooks were disabled)'; }

hooks.//: auto-feed Claude the latest git changes
hooks.command:
echo "## Repo state
Branch: $(git branch --show-current)

Uncommitted changes:
$(git status --short)

Last 5 commits:
$(git log --oneline -5)"

SessionStart.//: warn when other Claude Code sessions share this checkout; suggest EnterWorktree

hooks.//: CLAUDE.md is a 1-line @AGENTS.md import; rules belong in AGENTS.md
extend the `java` skill with .claude/java-ext.md, as a team plugin would.
hooks.//2: Filtering on the skill name has to happen inside the script: `matcher` only
hooks.//3: sees the tool name, and `if: Skill(java)` — the documented argument filter —
hooks.//4: silently stops the hook from firing at all. Measured 2026-09-02, v2.1.258.

hooks.//: automatically watch and fix the CI after a push
